title: OpsAPI · User Activity
description: Who signed in, when, from where, and what they did. Per-user data from Postgres (opsapi_reporting views); aggregates from Prometheus. Admins only.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Workspace
list.definition: SELECT slug AS __text, namespace_id AS __value FROM opsapi_reporting.namespaces ORDER BY slug
list.query: SELECT slug AS __text, namespace_id AS __value FROM opsapi_reporting.namespaces ORDER BY slug

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query:
SELECT coalesce(u.email, u.user_uuid) AS __text, u.user_uuid AS __value FROM opsapi_reporting.users u
WHERE (${namespace} = -1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = u.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))
ORDER BY u.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Active now (5 min)
panels.description: Signed-in users with any request in the last 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opsapi_reporting.users u
WHERE u.last_seen_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  AND (${namespace} = -1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = u.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opsapi_reporting.users u
WHERE u.last_seen_at >= date_trunc('day', now())
  AND (${namespace} = -1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = u.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))

panels.title: Active in range
panels.description: Distinct users with activity in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_uuid) AS value FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})

SELECT coalesce(sum(hits), 0) AS value FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events e
WHERE e.event = 'login' AND e.result = 'success'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = e.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events e
WHERE e.event = 'login' AND e.result = 'failure'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR e.user_uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = e.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 1d), count(DISTINCT user_uuid) AS "active users"
FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 1h),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'success') AS "succeeded",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'failure') AS "failed"
FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events e
WHERE e.event = 'login' AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)
  AND (${namespace} = -1 OR e.user_uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = e.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 1h),
       coalesce(sum(hits) FILTER (WHERE method IN ('POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE')), 0) AS "changes",
       coalesce(sum(hits) FILTER (WHERE method IN ('GET', 'HEAD')), 0) AS "reads"
FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Users: last login and last seen (click a user for their activity)
panels.description: Everyone in the selected workspace. 'Failed since last login' resets on a successful sign-in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.email AS "User", u.name AS "Name",
       (SELECT string_agg(m.namespace_slug, ', ' ORDER BY m.namespace_slug)
        FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = u.user_uuid) AS "Workspaces",
       u.last_login_at AS "Last login", u.last_login_method AS "Method", u.last_login_ip AS "Login IP",
       u.last_seen_at AS "Last seen", u.login_count AS "Logins",
       u.failed_login_count AS "Failed since last login", u.active AS "Active", u.user_uuid AS "UUID"
FROM opsapi_reporting.users u
WHERE (${namespace} = -1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opsapi_reporting.memberships m WHERE m.user_uuid = u.user_uuid AND m.namespace_id = ${namespace}))
ORDER BY u.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST, u.last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Activity timeline
panels.description: Changes are listed one by one; identical reads within a minute are merged ('Times').

targets.rawSql:
SELECT occurred_at AS "Time", namespace_slug AS "Workspace", action AS "Action", method AS "Method",
       route AS "Route", entity_id AS "Record", status AS "Status", hits AS "Times",
       duration_ms AS "Duration", ip AS "IP", via AS "Via", request_id AS "Request id"
FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE user_uuid = '${user}' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT action AS "Action", sum(hits) AS "Count"
FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE user_uuid = '${user}' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})
GROUP BY action ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 1h), sum(hits) AS "actions"
FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE user_uuid = '${user}' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT occurred_at AS "Time", event AS "Event", result AS "Result", method AS "Method", ip AS "IP",
       reason AS "Reason", user_agent AS "Browser"
FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events
WHERE user_uuid = '${user}' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT coalesce(email, '(unknown)') AS "Account", count(*) AS "Failures",
       count(DISTINCT ip) AS "From IPs", max(occurred_at) AS "Last attempt"
FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events
WHERE event = 'login' AND result = 'failure' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Failed sign-ins by IP
panels.description: Many accounts from one IP suggests credential stuffing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ip AS "IP", count(*) AS "Failures", count(DISTINCT coalesce(email, '')) AS "Accounts tried",
       max(occurred_at) AS "Last attempt"
FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events
WHERE event = 'login' AND result = 'failure' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Accounts signing in from many IPs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(email, user_uuid) AS "Account", count(DISTINCT ip) AS "IPs", count(*) AS "Sign-ins",
       max(occurred_at) AS "Last sign-in"
FROM opsapi_reporting.auth_events
WHERE event = 'login' AND result = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT ip) > 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Auth events (Prometheus, all pods)
panels.description: Includes rate-limited attempts, which are counted but not stored per request.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(namespace_slug, '(none)') AS "Workspace", count(DISTINCT user_uuid) AS "Active users",
       sum(hits) AS "Actions",
       sum(hits) FILTER (WHERE method IN ('POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE')) AS "Changes",
       max(occurred_at) AS "Last activity"
FROM opsapi_reporting.user_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (${namespace} = -1 OR namespace_id = ${namespace})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Entries dropped (range)
panels.description: Activity not stored because the database was unavailable or a worker's buffer was full.
